not_sampled.run_end: no call the harness makes prints a meter event after its last call (agent, judge or guard) has started (one real call observed: one event, as the call began); reading the meter at run end would need an added call

cost_estimate.basis: an estimate from the CLI's own per-call dollar figures (total_cost_usd, else modelUsage costUSD), times the measured points-per-dollar rate; not a meter reading

reasons.points_per_usd: calibrated at ingest, where the ingested runs are: routine-results/<run id>/cost_estimate.json
reasons.points: calibrated at ingest, where the ingested runs are: routine-results/<run id>/cost_estimate.json

reasons.concurrent_runs: not knowable inside one run; computed at ingest
reasons.price_table_version: costs are the CLI's own figures; it names a cost basis, not a price table version
